heading: Today
text: A few patches of fog early. Morning sun giving way to clouds. Showers or thunderstorms increasing through NY into southwest VT and the Berkshires, spreading northeast in the afternoon. Highs in the 70s to around 80. Winds becoming south to southeast near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Numerous showers or a thunderstorm from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 south, scattered to the north. Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s, some mid 60s near Lake Champlain. Winds southeast near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley this evening.

heading: Wednesday
text: Numerous showers from I-89 west and south. Mostly cloudy, maybe a glimpse of sun northeast, with a chance of showers, especially in the afternoon. Highs in the 70s, closer to 80 northeast. Winds southeast, becoming east, up to 10 mph north, 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph south.
